sourceSectionFilterAuditRows.sectionTitle: The BS in Environmental Science provides students with a strong science background with a focus on the environmental issues of the future. Through lecture, lab and field classes, you will get hands-on experience with biology, chemistry, the geosciences, physics and math. In this major, students learn how to draw connections between the disciplines needed to solve the complex environmental problems facing their local community and society at large. A Capstone experience gives you the opportunity to work with a scientist on your own undergraduate research project or to intern with a community group to gain practical experience.
